FeedbackAnswer.description:
One answer a nurse gave on one of this resident's alerts (SPEC MVP 8).

`routine_watch.feedback.FeedbackStore.history`'s row: one per alert, because
answering an alert again replaces its answer rather than piling a second one on
top. Not `AlertFeedback`, which is the verdict as the alert itself carries it:
this is the same answer read from the resident's side, with the alert it was
about named and the `by` nobody logs in to set left off.

alert_id.description: The alert this answer was given on.
alert_id.title: Alert Id

cause.description: The answer to "what was it?" (SPEC section 5, MVP 8): a pattern_id from the pattern library, 'other' for a cause the library has no pattern for, or null when nobody said. Always sent, often null.
cause.title: Cause

FeedbackAnswer.title: FeedbackAnswer

FeedbackVerdict.description: The nurse's answer to an alert, which tunes this resident's threshold.
FeedbackVerdict.title: FeedbackVerdict

description:
What this resident's nurses have said (`GET /residents/{id}/feedback`).

The record behind the feedback loop (SPEC Nice to have 8), which until this route
only showed up in how her next alert was ranked: every answer on her alerts
newest first, the pattern weights those answers add up to, and the name the
library shows each pattern id named here under, so the card reading this never
keeps its own copy of the library. All three are always sent and all three can be
empty - nobody having answered yet is a real answer, not a gap.

answers.description: One row per answered alert, newest first. Empty until a nurse answers.
answers.title: Answers

pattern_weights.description: Pattern id -> confidence multiplier, one entry per pattern her nurses have answered about (`routine_watch.feedback.FeedbackStore.pattern_weights`). A pattern missing here is unweighted, which is read as 1.0.
pattern_weights.title: Pattern Weights

pattern_names.description: Pattern id -> how the pattern library shows it, for every id named above that the library knows. 'other' is a real answer with no pattern to name, so it has no entry here.
pattern_names.title: Pattern Names

title: ResidentFeedback
